persona_snapshot.name: Skeptical bookkeeper
persona_snapshot.summary: Checks every number and doesn't accept an answer without the detail behind it.
persona_snapshot.speaking_style: Measured and exact. Asks for amounts and dates to be repeated, and says "let me just write that down".

scenario_snapshot.title: Double charge refund
scenario_snapshot.description: One invoice was charged twice. The bot should refund only the duplicate, which is within its limit.
scenario_snapshot.goal: You were charged twice for your October invoice and you want the extra charge refunded.

beats.instruction: Say you see two charges for the same invoice on your card and you want one back.
beats.checkpoint: The caller said they were charged twice.

beats.instruction: Give your domain or phone so the agent can find your account, then your billing zip and PIN when asked.
Give the invoice id if asked, and say yes when the agent offers to refund the duplicate.
beats.checkpoint: The caller agreed to a refund of one charge.

beats.instruction: Ask when the money comes back to your card, then say thanks and goodbye.

must.text: Verify the caller with billing zip and PIN before discussing invoice details.
State the $49.99 refund amount and get a yes before issuing it.

must_not.text: Refund both payments on the invoice.

expected_state.description: One refund of the duplicate payment.
The invoice was validly paid once and stays paid.
